description: Make the canonical Timber Room and real timber pile stateful/burnable without altering the EMPTY-HANDED crawl rule.

replacements.old:
<OBJECT TIMBERS
	(IN TIMBER-ROOM)
	(SYNONYM TIMBERS PILE)
	(ADJECTIVE WOODEN BROKEN)
	(DESC "broken timber")
	(FLAGS TAKEBIT)
	(SIZE 50)>
replacements.new:
<OBJECT TIMBERS
	(IN TIMBER-ROOM)
	(SYNONYM TIMBERS TIMBER PILE WOOD)
	(ADJECTIVE WOODEN BROKEN DRY OLD)
	(DESC "broken timber")
	(FLAGS TAKEBIT BURNBIT)
	(ACTION FIRE-TIMBERS-FCN)
	(SIZE 50)>

replacements.old:
<ROOM TIMBER-ROOM	;"was TIMBE"
      (IN ROOMS)
      (LDESC
"This is a long and narrow passage, which is cluttered with broken
timbers. A wide passage comes from the east and turns at the
west end of the room into a very narrow passageway. From the west
comes a strong draft.")
      (DESC "Timber Room")
      (EAST TO LADDER-BOTTOM)
      (WEST TO LOWER-SHAFT
       IF EMPTY-HANDED
       ELSE "You cannot fit through this passage with that load.")
      (ACTION NO-OBJS)
      (FLAGS RLANDBIT SACREDBIT)>
replacements.new:
<ROOM TIMBER-ROOM	;"was TIMBE"
      (IN ROOMS)
      (DESC "Timber Room")
      (EAST TO LADDER-BOTTOM)
      (WEST TO LOWER-SHAFT
       IF EMPTY-HANDED
       ELSE "You cannot fit through this passage with that load.")
      (ACTION FIRE-TIMBER-ROOM-FCN)
      (FLAGS RLANDBIT SACREDBIT)>
